messages:
Priya (Design): quick UX check — for the new Route creation form, should we show inline errors immediately, only on blur, or show a summary at submit? Ben (Eng): prefer onBlur for most fields, inline for fast feedback. summary at submit for server errors. Maria (PM): product ask: reduce friction. many customers hit validation on first-run flows. inline errors onChange can feel noisy. Sam (Frontend): inline onChange is brutal for typing. onBlur + live summary works well. also suggest we mark required fields with a single asterisk and add '(optional)' on the rest — that reduces label clutter. Noor (Research): research shows users prefer visible required markers on long forms. but we should also provide clear inline copy for the error, not just red outline. Priya (Design): proposed pattern: show asterisk on labels, show '(optional)' on optional fields, perform basic validation onBlur (format, length), run full validation on submit and show a top summary that links to fields. Maria (PM): copy tweak proposal for errors: use plain language + remediation. e.g., 'Name: Enter a display name up to 64 characters.' rather than 'Invalid input'. Ben (Eng): accessibility nits: when we show inline error, set aria-invalid="true" on the input and aria-describedby to the error id. also use role="alert" on the summary so screen readers announce it. Priya (Design): example UI copy for destructive confirm (Delete route): 'Delete route "staging-webhook" — this action cannot be undone.' and require typing the route name as confirmation? seems heavy. thoughts? Sam (Frontend): typed-confirm is safest for production-critical deletes (models, deployments). but for small things a modal with clear CTA + undo toast is less disruptive. we should decide by risk level. Noor (Research): participants in tests get annoyed by typed-confirm for every delete. suggestion: typed-confirm for irreversible infra actions (delete dedicated capacity, private deployment) and simple modal + undo for smaller items. Maria (PM): agree on risk tiers. add policy: Tier 1 (irreversible/critical) = typed-confirm + strong warning. Tier 2 = modal confirm + undo. Priya (Design): accessibility details for modals: focus trap, keyboard accessible, default focus on cancel, clear aria-label and descriptive text. include reason text for the action. a11y-bot: checklist reminder: ensure error messages are programmatically associated, do not rely on color alone, provide >=4.5:1 contrast for error text, focus moves to the summary when shown. Ben (Eng): implementation notes: we'll need unique ids for errors and summary links, and smooth scroll to first invalid field. can add small helper in our form lib. Sam (Frontend): code sketch for error association: ```
Enter a name (max 64 chars)
``` Priya (Design): one more copy nit: show 'Required' only in aria for screen readers? or visible asterisk + sr-only 'required' text? Noor (Research): visible asterisk + sr-only text works best — it gives visual cue and accessibility support. Maria (PM): decision summary: 1) required = asterisk + sr-only 'required' text 2) validate onBlur for inline checks, full validation on submit with top summary 3) aria-invalid/aria-describedby for errors + role=alert on summaries 4) destructive confirmations by risk tier (typed-confirm for Tier 1, modal+undo for Tier 2) 5) copy: explicit remediation text. Priya (Design): I'll update the mock with these rules and post new screens. tagging @Ben and @Sam for implementation estimates. :thumbsup: Ben (Eng): I'll scope a small form utils PR for ids, scroll, and aria helpers. aim this sprint. Sam (Frontend): can take the front-end bits after Ben's helpers land. Noor (Research): I'll draft short usability tasks to validate the new pattern next week. Priya (Design): thanks everyone. closing thread unless more comments. Maria (PM): thank you — nice fast sync. Sam (Frontend): :rocket:
